follow-up time: From birth to first hospitalization with infectious morbidity
exposure: Mode of conception (IVF, ovulation induction, spontaneous)
cohort: Singleton infants born between 1991 and 2014 and discharged alive from a regional university medical center
finding: Offspring conceived after fertility treatments (IVF or ovulation induction) had a higher risk of infectious morbidity and hospitalization for infectious morbidity compared to spontaneously conceived offspring, even after adjusting for maternal and birth-related factors.
followup_time: From birth to first hospitalization with infectious morbidity
